_comment: MassHealth PT-1 (renamed 'Provider Request for Transportation' per TRN-33, 2017). Submitted on the MassHealth Customer Web Portal (CWP). Once approved, rides are scheduled through a broker (MART or GATRA). The live CWP form is behind a provider login (fetch returned HTTP 403), so exact on-screen field LABELS/ORDER are not pinned; the field SET and the mode/MNF/recurrence semantics are confirmed from MassHealth bulletins. Values fill /plan pt1_prefill (docs/contracts.md). Synthetic patients only.
form_name: Provider Request for Transportation (formerly Prescription for Transportation)

source.vintage: TRN-33 rename 2017; wheelchair-van CWP change APB-339 (2022); service-animal APB-218 (2011)
source.verified: field set + semantics verified from bulletins; exact live-form labels not pinned

fields.label: Eligible for Transportation (member must be eligible to proceed)
fields.note: Named in the online how-to; submission blocked if not eligible.

fields.label: Member pickup / residence address
fields.note: Authorized only for the addresses on the PT-1; new request needed within 30 days of address change.

fields.label: Is the treating provider the same as the submitter?
Treating provider NPI
fields.note: Searched by NPI or last name + zip when treating provider differs.

fields.label: Member accompanied by a service animal?
Requested mode of transportation
fields.note: APB-339: PT-1 required for wheelchair van and sedan via CWP. Wheelchair van + ambulance also require the separate MNF (below). Public transit is NOT a PT-1 mode.

fields.label: Authorization effective date range
fields.note: Authorization window; broker schedules individual trips within it.

related_form_MNF.name: Medical Necessity Form (MNF) for Nonemergency Ambulance / Wheelchair Van
related_form_MNF.relationship: SEPARATE form, NOT PT-1 fields. Required for wheelchair-van and nonemergency-ambulance modes to document medical necessity. Transportation provider completes it and retains it 6 years.

recurrence_note.handling: The PT-1 has NO per-visit frequency field. Recurring trips (e.g. dialysis 3x/week) are handled by the broker (MART/GATRA) scheduling repeat rides AFTER a single PT-1 approval for that destination. One PT-1 per location/service.

MISSING_MANUAL_CHECK: Exact on-screen field LABELS and ORDER on the live CWP form are not pinned (the portal is behind a provider login; fetch 403'd). The field SET, the transport-mode enum, the MNF relationship, and recurrence handling ARE confirmed from MassHealth bulletins. OPTIONAL for the demo: a provider-portal user can screenshot the live form to pin exact labels. Not blocking — /plan pt1_prefill keys off the stable `key` values here, not the display labels.
_id_source_note: id = planner field id (planner/pt1.py); source = planner value key that pre-fills it, or null when a person fills it. The MassHealth determination box is always null: MassHealth decides, never this tool.
